1508.criterion: - [ ] With a profile window kept open or a publish running, the main page says it shows a saved version, why, and what to do.
1508.evidence: test_notice_states_saved_version_reason_and_action and test_page_shows_the_saved_report_and_waits_during_a_publish (tests/test_acl2260_report_rebuild_deferred.py) assert the DEFERRED_TEXT notice says saved version, why (profile window open / publish running) and what to do; passed on main 54e167d16 and main CI 43009812967.

1508.criterion: - [ ] Pressing Refresh in that state either shows the fresh report or tells the buyer clearly that it cannot be shown yet and why.
1508.evidence: test_refresh_while_busy_makes_the_page_ready_and_serves_fresh and test_refresh_warms_the_period_of_the_page assert Refresh builds the page period and serves the fresh report while busy; test_refresh_endpoint_reads_period_from_query_and_referer, test_referer_is_used_only_when_same_origin and test_refresh_ignores_malformed_period_and_never_caches_it cover the period input. Passed on main.

1508.criterion: - [ ] Once the window is closed or the publish ends, the page serves the fresh report and no notice remains.
1508.evidence: test_notice_is_hidden_when_not_deferred and test_page_starts_the_rebuild_when_idle assert that once idle the fresh report is served with no notice. Passed on main.

1509.criterion: - [ ] After connecting an account, the country selection stays the same.
1509.evidence: Test test_the_page_code_keeps_country_and_selects_new_account and test_connect_remembers_the_country_before_the_form_runs (tests/test_acl2509_connect_keeps_country.py) assert the country is parked in sessionStorage before the connect form runs and restored on reload (takePick/resolvePick in report.html); passed on main 54e167d16 (tree equals reviewed tree 428241f60) and in main CI 43009812967.

1509.criterion: - [ ] The newly connected account is selected in the account drop-down.
1509.evidence: test_the_drawer_applies_the_parked_pick_when_it_paints asserts paintFoot applies the parked pick (keep=country, keepAccount=the account not in the earlier list); a node harness (tests/acl2509_pick_harness.cjs) drives resolvePick. Passed on main.

1509.criterion: - [ ] A test covers the connect flow.
1509.evidence: tests/test_acl2509_connect_keeps_country.py (4 tests, incl. the connect flow, never-touch-storage-in-paint, parked-pick-applied) added and passed on main 54e167d16 and in main CI.

main is still 4c63ef0c; the PR base is 4c63ef0c and the PR is MERGEABLE. The diff vs main has 22 files, 1768-only: no targeting_resolver.py / test_acl1771 changes, so the 1771 code now comes from main.

### Merge 74eb343a vs my merge notes
I rebuilt my resolved trial tree (main + my resolution) and compared it with 74eb343a. The `src` difference is limited to a removed comment, the order of the copy_more/file_vertical lines in app.py, and an en-dash in a JS comment. tests/test_acl1819_preflight.py adds the new 2-ad-set texts_dynamic parity fixtures. 1. **Targeting reads.** `estimate_targeting_reads` = min(90, 6 + 6 × distinct terms and parts across all sets) is added to the per-campaign budget. The write-refusal threshold stays at 250, and the env ceiling is 250+90. I reran my FakeMeta repro (10 sets × 3 ads × 3 work-position terms, cold cache): budget 330, 252 calls used, success. With 4 terms per set the resolver cap is hit and the run is refused before any write ("press Check plan again"); this is 1771 behaviour. 2 sets × 3 terms: success.
2. **ACL-1891.** `_prepare` refuses before the first write when `chunk_calls + estimate_create_calls(plan) > budget`. Check plan (`writing=False`) keeps the old reserve. The 1891 test is rewritten and a new test is added; the 1891 suite passes.

- **Remaining-budget comment is inaccurate.** The comments say "if writes don't fit after the reads, `_prepare` refuses before the first write". The code only checks when there are large-video chunks. For non-video plans, the targeting reserve is the only guard. One edge: the resolver is shared across campaigns of one job, and its job cap is cumulative (`len(_results)`), so a later campaign can in theory read more than its own reserve. Cheap hardening for a follow-up: an unconditional `client.max_calls - client.calls < estimate_create_calls(plan)` refusal at the end of `_prepare` when writing.
- **The concurrent-confirm test failure is not a lock race.** The 1771 test `test_concurrent_confirms_do_not_lose_entries` (11 == 12 under load) passes in my full group run and in 150 extra 12-thread loops. `ConfirmedStore.put` holds `_STORE_LOCK` around read → modify → atomic replace, so in-process writes are serialized.     - `_read` maps any OSError, including PermissionError, to `{}`, and the next `put` would then rewrite the file with only the new entry, dropping the confirmed cache;

BLOCKER: the parked pick is consumed before the page reloads, so the fix does not work in the real flow.
In the connect click handler (report.html, act === 'connect' / 'connect-picked'): `rememberPick(country); paint();`.
paint() calls paintFoot() unconditionally (line ~8934); paintFoot() is not deferred by footBusy() because the focused element is the clicked button, not a SELECT/INPUT/TEXTAREA. paintFoot() now calls takePick(), the country is in places(), resolvePick() returns a hit, and takePick() removes the sessionStorage key immediately ("used once").
